Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:59470
Court No. - 14

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 10756 of 2023
Applicant :- Dr. Acchan @ Shahid Siddiqi
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Vashu Deo Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.
1.

Learned A.G.A. informs that he has procured complete instructions in the matter including upto
date case diary of the case and charge sheet in this case has already been filed way back in the year
2000.

2. Heard learned counsel for the accused-applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
3.

This bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Dr. Acchan @ Shahid Siddiqi for grant of bail, in Case Crime No.143 of 1999, under Sections 376, 364, 384, 120-B I.P.C., Police Station Purwa, District Unnao, during trial.

4. Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the bail application submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case and he has not committed any offence as claimed Dr. Acchan @ Shahid Siddiqi vs State Of U.P Thru. sentences.text: 5. It is further submitted that F.I.R. of the incident has been lodged on 07.04.1999 at Police Station Purwa, District Unnao by the brother of the victim against three named accused persons namely Soeb Ahmad, Arif and Rais Ahmad and the applicant was not named in the F.I.R.

After recovery of the victim her statement under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. were recorded and in the statement of the victim also, no direct allegation has been levelled and the allegation of committing sexual assault has been levelled against the named accused persons and only imputation, which has been levelled against the applicant, is of making some phone calls to the accused persons, which was incidentally overheard by the victim.
6. It is vehemently submitted that identification of the applicant is claimed to have been done from his voice, which is not possible as the prosecutrix has claimed to have identified the voice of the applicant, which was coming from the receiver of phone.

It is further submitted that after filing of charge sheet, the applicant has approached this Court by filing Criminal Misc. Case No.711 of 1999 (under Section 482 Cr.P.C.) and vide order dated 16.09.1999 the same was disposed of with an opportunity provided to the applicant to move an appropriate application before the magistrate in order to weigh as to whether the case is worth committal and vide order dated 29.11.2000, the time frame was extended by the Coordinate Bench of this Court and in pursuance of the same, an application was moved before the Chief Judicial Magistrate on 14.12.2000, which could only be decided on 23.05.2023.

7. It is vehemently submitted that the Chief Judicial Magistrate concerned has committed manifest illegality in rejecting the application of the applicant as there was no material/evidence available against the applicant, which may even prima facie connect the applicant with the crime and there is no material/evidence, which may attract the penal provisions as contained under Section 120-B I.P.C.
8.

It is further submitted that for the last twenty years the applicant is under constant pressure as his application could not be disposed of by the magisterial court and when the case was committed to the court of Sessions, application for bail was moved and the same has been rejected by passing the order dated 10.08.2023.
The other co-accused persons have been convicted by the trial court and an appeal against the said order has been preferred before a Coordinate Bench of this Court.

9. It is next submitted that applicant is in jail in this case since 26.07.2023 and he is not having any criminal history, charge-sheet in this case has already been submitted and there is no apprehension that after being released on bail the applicant may flee from the course of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.

10. Learned A.G.A., however, opposes the prayer of bail of the applicant on the ground that the applicant has committed an heinous offence and he was also instrumental in keeping his application pending before the magisterial court, therefore, applicant is not entitled to be released on bail, but could not controvert the other factual submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant.

sentences.text: Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that the only allegation, which has been levelled by the prosecutrix against the applicant, is that he had made some phone calls to the other accused persons when the prosecutrix/victim was held captive by them.
The voice of the applicant is claimed to have been identified by the prosecutrix as she claimed to have overheard the same from the speaker of the landline telephone.
Various submissions have been raised on behalf of the applicant in order to show that identification on the basis of voice alone may not be sufficient to implicate the applicant.

Coordinate Bench of this Court way back in the year 1999 had provided an opportunity to the applicant to move an application before the magistrate in order to show that the case is not worth triable by the court of Sessions, however, the same could only be disposed of by the magistrate concerned on 23.05.2023 after 23 years of its filing.

In this regard an explanation was called from the magistrate concerned and vide communication dated 01.09.2023, the same has been submitted to this Court, wherein it is stated by the magistrate concerned that the record of the case could only be received in his court on 12.05.2023 under the orders of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Unnao dated 13.02.2023 and after receiving the record on 12.05.2023, he immediately disposed of the application of the applicant on 23.05.2023 and the case has already been committed to the court of Sessions.

Co-accused persons, against whom specific role of committing sexual assault, is shown have been convicted by the trial court and an appeal against the same is pending before a Coordinate Bench of this Court.
Charge-sheet in this case has already been filed.
Applicant is in jail in this case since 26.07.2023 without any previous criminal history.
The presence of the applicant could be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.

Having regard to all the facts and circumstances of the case and the material, which has been collected by the investigating officer against the instant applicant and also the statement of the victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. and having regard to the period for which the application moved by the applicant has remained pending before the magisterial court, in the considered opinion of this Court, facility of bail may be extended to the applicant, however, subject to certain conditions.

12. Having regard to the overall facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is thus allowed.

13. Let the accused/applicant- Dr. Acchan @ Shahid Siddiqi involved in above-mentioned case, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.

sentences.text: In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
15. Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the Court concerned before the bonds are accepted.
16. Observations made herein-above by this court are only for the purpose of disposal of this bail application and shall not be construed as an expression of this Court on the merits of the case.

17. Before parting it appears necessary to highlight that an application was moved by the applicant before the magisterial court in the year 2000 under the orders of this Court passed in the year 1999 and the same could only be disposed of in the year 2023.

In order to eliminate the possibility of any other such application pending before the magisterial court, it appears to be desirable that a copy of this order be placed before the District Judge, Unnao for taking appropriate action in the matter.
